We plan to implement graphical user interfaces for enhanced workflow specification, enable seamless interfacing with cloud platforms and specialized optimization solvers, and conduct comprehensive user studies to validate practical applicability. Furthermore, we will investigate generating JSON stage definitions through human-in-the loop Large Language Model methods to further abstract co-design formulation from low-level code development. These enhancements will strengthen CAMEO’s position as a general-purpose computational framework for complex system optimization across diverse engineering disciplines.
